{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|Shu Mai|<ref name="AS" />}}
The '''Malarian Alliance''' was a treaty signed by representatives from four [[star system/Legends|systems]] in the decades prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The members were [[Mamendin system/Legends|Mamendin]], its colony [[Malari system/Legends|Malari]], [[Dbari system/Legends|Dbari]] and nearby [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Alliance joined the worlds together in both commerce and defense. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] attempted to force [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;hoping that the other worlds, bound by their respective treaties, would follow suit, and thus add more planets and [[Star system/Legends|systems]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] cause.<ref name="AS" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], such alliances were annulled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to eliminate potential threats to its authority; obscure planets such as Ansion became again independent and isolated.<ref name="atlas" />
